name: Burner rotation
summary: A rotation of Sunday dinners drawn as a stovetop: four burners, one per Sunday, each with its cook's face and dish. Drag your face onto another burner to swap weeks, tap an open burner to take it; this Sunday's burner is lit, with a grocery list underneath anyone can tick off.
useWhen: we should do family dinner sundays (said every semester)
take turns cooking for the house this month
who's cooking next week, can i swap with someone
rotating dinner hosts for the group, one per week
set up a cooking schedule for the apartment with groceries
dontUseWhen: a one-off potluck where everyone brings something (use potluck)
weekly chores that aren't cooking (use chore-wheel)
the shopping list on its own (use grocery)

sub.description: Line under the title, e.g. the thing the chat keeps saying

weeks.description: Up to 4 dinners in order. date: short, e.g. 'Nov 16'; cook: a chat member's name or '' if open; dish: in their words; groceries: up to 6 things to buy; got: groceries already bought; done: already cooked

current.description: Which week is the next dinner, counting from 0
